scripts.build: npm exec --package=pnpm -- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && npm exec --package=pnpm -- pnpm --filter @workspace/elimu-pawa run build && npm exec --package=pnpm -- pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.start: NODE_ENV=production npm exec --package=pnpm -- pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
